items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06

ctx.x: Well, I don't have quit. It's still alive. Like, Mealy Barnes never plays anymore. No. He says his mouth is all corroded. Yes, ma'am. That's his word for it. All corroded. I was both corroded. The first time I was ever there. Yeah, that's what he said.
I can't blame my mouth's all corroded. Who was in that old tuxedo, Brad's family, those days? Oh, we can't doubt.
Happy Goldstein. Mm-hmm. And, uh, Ernest Reppens. And, uh, Ernest Reppens. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
